card.name: Second digit of two-digit dose numbers
card.fires_on: A single digit such as 2, 4, 8 or 6 that is the second digit of a number being written out, such as 72, 24, 18 or 96. It appears in dose, volume and time amounts, usually before a unit.

modes.label: Digit inside a dose
modes.description: The digit 2, 4 or 8 partway through a dose amount in mg, before the unit.
modes.example: Do not exceed a dose of 7<<2>> mg daily.

modes.label: Digit inside a time or volume
modes.description: The digit partway through a number of hours or mL.
modes.example: Initiate therapy with allopurinol tablets 2<<4>> hours to 48 hours before the

card.writes: It lowers the chance that the next word is minutes, so the number is more likely to continue or be followed by mg or hours.
card.plain: It marks the middle of a number like 72 or 24 in a dose or time, where the unit has not yet appeared.
